svg.aria-label: OpenCode automation press: a clockwork press that fires scheduled agent runs. Four trigger pins on the rack — once, interval, cron and MCP event — set when a run fires; the clock drum on the press crown decides the moment; the lit approval key is turned once when an automation is created; run cards slide under the lit stamp and out to three action trays — prompt, script and shell command — and every stamped run is recorded in the log ledger. The numbers are the verified ones: v2.4.0, Nov 23, 2026, 4 triggers, 3 actions, 1 approval at creation, 0 runs without a log.
svg.text: v2.4.0 · NOV 23, 2026 · 4 TRIGGERS · 3 ACTIONS · 1 APPROVAL AT CREATION · 0 RUNS WITHOUT A LOG
